knowledge:
- key_parameters: input=The input SpatialExperiment object or raw count matrix ;; stabilize=Logical parameter in generate_weights() indicating whether to stabilize weights to prevent extreme values ;; w=The weights matrix generated by generate_weights() and passed to weighted_nnSVG() ;; BPPARAM=A BiocParallelParam object defining the parallelization backend and RNG seed for reproducibility
- alternatives: nnSVG=Standard spatially variable gene detection without mean-variance weighting; use spoon when you want to remove the confounding effect of the mean-variance relationship. Other SVG detection tools=Can be used instead of weighted_nnSVG by manually scaling the logcounts matrix with the generated weights using the Delta method.
- when_to_use: Appropriate for spatially resolved transcriptomics data (such as Visium) when identifying spatially variable genes (SVGs) while controlling for the technical bias where gene-level variance correlates with mean expression.
- pitfalls: Low quality genes and spots with zero counts must be filtered out before running generate_weights() and weighted_nnSVG() to avoid errors (e.g., "Rows (genes) and/or columns (spots) containing all zero counts have been found"). Ensure the input data is properly preprocessed with log-transformed normalized counts (logcounts assay) before generating weights.

workflows.name: weighted_nnsvg_workflow
workflows.intent: Identify spatially variable genes in spatial transcriptomics data using weighted nearest-neighbor Gaussian process regression to control for the mean-variance relationship.
input: spe (SpatialExperiment object containing spatial transcriptomics data with raw counts and spatial coordinates)
workflows.stages: 1. Filter out low-quality genes and spots with zero counts ;; 2. Compute library size factors and log-normalize counts ;; 3. Generate observation weights using generate_weights() ;; 4. Run weighted SVG detection using weighted_nnSVG() ;; 5. Retrieve results from the rowData of the SpatialExperiment object
workflows.code:
spe <- spe[, colData(spe)$in_tissue == 1]
spe <- filter_genes(spe)
spe <- computeLibraryFactors(spe)
spe <- logNormCounts(spe)
set.seed(3)
ix_random <- sample(seq_len(nrow(spe)), 10)
spe <- spe[ix_random, ]
spe <- spe[, colSums(logcounts(spe)) > 0]
weights <- generate_weights(input = spe,
                            stabilize = TRUE,
                            BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 1,
                                                     RNGseed = 4))
spe <- weighted_nnSVG(input = spe,
                      w = weights,
                      BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 1, RNGseed = 5))
rowData(spe)

workflows.name: custom_weighted_svg_workflow
workflows.intent: Generate weights and rescale logcounts to use with alternative spatially variable gene detection tools that do not natively support weights.
input: spe (SpatialExperiment object containing spatial transcriptomics data with logcounts)
workflows.stages: 1. Generate observation weights using generate_weights() ;; 2. Rescale the logcounts matrix by multiplying with the transposed weights ;; 3. Store the rescaled matrix as a new assay "weighted_logcounts" in the SpatialExperiment object
workflows.code:
weights <- generate_weights(input = spe,
                            stabilize = TRUE,
                            BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 1,
                                                     RNGseed = 4))
assay_name <- "logcounts"
weighted_logcounts <- t(weights)*assays(spe)[[assay_name]]
assay(spe, "weighted_logcounts") <- weighted_logcounts
